subject: YEAR-TO-YYYY function
notes: PARTIAL -> CONFORMS, re-verdicted by the kb/Work PB245 golden round (2026-09-09). THE RULE: §15.100.3 r3 'If argument-2 is omitted, the function shall be evaluated as though 50 were specified for argument-2' (cite.py --check 15.100.3 on that sentence -> OK, rule 3). §15.100.2's format nests argument-3 inside argument-2's brackets, so the ONLY reference r3 governs is the one-argument form. DERIVED BEFORE THE RUN from the standard's own expressions rather than from a calendar year: argument-3 defaults per r5 to FUNCTION NUMVAL(FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE(1:4)), maximum-year is §15.100.4 r1's (argument-2 + argument-3) with r3's 50, and the returned value is r2a/r2b transcribed verbatim. MEASURED: the one-argument reference equals that expression for argument-1 = 0, 30, 76 and 99 - four values straddling the r2a/r2b split whatever MOD(maximum-year,100) is in the year of the run - and equals the TWO-argument form with 50 WRITTEN, which is r3 itself. THE ROW'S RESIDUE WAS THE FLOAT CARRIER AND BOTH OF ITS HALVES ARE NOW ANSWERED. (1) The recorded repro - FUNCTION YEAR-TO-YYYY(F) over a COMP-2 F - is no longer conforming source: kb/Work PB248 rejects a floating-point item at every §15.3 type-6 argument position (COBOL1627, measured at 2002/2014/2023 and now fixtured by conformance:cases/15.100.3-Arguments-rule/l1-year-to-yyyy-float-item), so the Real lane is unreachable except under --permissive's documented coercion. (2) Under --permissive it now ANSWERS CORRECTLY: measured 2026-09-09 with the clock at 2026, YEAR-TO-YYYY(F)=2076, (F 23)=1976 and (F 60 3000)=2976, all three the derived values - kb/Work PB119 split RealArgs.YearToYyyyReal into the two overloads the exact core has, so the 1- and 2-argument forms call the two-argument CobolDate.YearToYyyy and no longer pass a baseYear 0 the program never wrote. The row's note ('RealArgs.cs line 107 is a SINGLE method ... so C# fills BOTH optionals') is stale. ⚠ The prior test-ref calls the C# API directly and never compiles a one-argument COBOL reference; it is kept as corroboration, not as the witness. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Intrinsics/CobolIntrinsics.RealArgs.cs#YearToYyyyReal (kb/Work PB651 deleted YearToYyyyReal: every YEAR-TO-YYYY position is 15.3 type 6, so a float argument reaches the one CobolDate.YearToYyyy body as its integer through IntrinsicRenderer.RawArg)
